prompt: Audit pinned representative project checkouts through critical tasks and mobile/desktop browser captures. Preserve UI source. Record actual QA duration, unresolved issues, expert visual observations and repair rounds. Compare the same project SHA under baseline and candidate verification; do not claim design improvement from gate changes.
expected_outcomes: Freeze source SHAs, route/state matrix and criteria before running
Record real browser task outcomes, overflow, runtime, media and axe evidence
Separate automated QA score from screenshot-based expert quality and human validation
Measure actual runner time and retain failures and zero or unperformed repair rounds honestly
Use identical target source and declared conditions in baseline and candidate
must_not: Manufacture participants or human task times
Treat partial browser coverage as full PASS
Hide unresolved project issues behind aggregate scores
Claim UI uplift when target source was unchanged
